abstract.t: [The original RFC 616 consisted of two one-page illustrations, which cannot be reproduced using ASCII characters. They are labeled:

"ARPA Network, Geographic Map, January 1974" and
"ARPA Network, Logical Map, January 1974"
[ This RFC was put into machine readable form for entry ] [ into the online RFC archives by Alex McKenzie with ] [ support from GTE, formerly BBN Corp. 11/99 ]
